links.surface: الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیِّ بْنِ بِنْتِ إِلْیَاسَ الْخَزَّازِ

notes: «بِنْتِ إِلْيَاسَ» is kept as written in the nasab; whether it is part of the name or a family designation is not settled by the text
«ع» after الرِّضَا is a blessing and is left out
«حَدَّثَنِی» repeated before each name is the transmission verb
